Hi Sam — great to meet you and thanks for the clear brief. I've put together a short baseline below and attached our standard ratecard. I'll loop in Ben (commercial) and Neha (solutions) for model-fit recommendations and any pricing flexibility.

Baseline hosted API (per 1M tokens) — standard (no committed discount):
- Lightweight / small-family (suitable for short assistants, low-latency): $2.50 input / $5.00 output per 1M tokens
- General-purpose (recommended for most chat/assistant workloads): $6.00 input / $12.00 output per 1M tokens
- Long-context / high-quality family (recommended for >16k / 32k contexts and long-form generation): $11.00 input / $22.00 output per 1M tokens

Notes:
- Streaming responses are billed the same as non-streamed output (output tokens billed at the output rate).
- Long-context surcharge: models certified for 32k context are priced in the "Long-context" family above; if you use a general-purpose model with extended context via segmented requests we usually recommend the Long-context family for predictable billing.
- For your sample profile (60M tokens / month, 20% input, 80% output) using the general-purpose family the math is: 
  * Input tokens: 12M -> 12 * $6.00 / 1M = $72.00
  * Output tokens: 48M -> 48 * $12.00 / 1M = $576.00
  * Estimated monthly cost = $648.00 (before any committed-discount)

Attached: redwood-standard-ratecard-v1.pdf (summary of model families and standard IO tiers). I've also included a sample calculation template if you want a shared spreadsheet — happy to fill it with your expected token mix.

If you'd like a formal quote or a 30-day pilot pricing for that 60M/month profile + SOC2 evidence, tell me who on procurement should receive the quote and I'll route to our quoting engine.

Best,
